card.name: Word just before a medical noun in a list
card.fires_on: A modifier or linking word that comes right before a medical noun, such as diabetic, peripheral, metabolic, orbital or including, often after a comma or bracket in a list of conditions. Also seen at the start of a borrowed word like perestroika.

modes.label: Adjective in a condition list
modes.description: An adjective or linking word after a comma or 'and' that introduces the next condition in a list.

modes.label: Including before a named disorder
modes.description: The word including after a heading about vascular disease, before Raynaud's.
modes.example: 5.6 Peripheral Vasculopathy,<< including>> Raynaud’s Phenomenon CNS

modes.label: Other noun modifiers
modes.description: A modifier before a noun in non-list text, such as a military district or a Russian term.

card.plain: It fires on a describing word that comes just before the name of a condition or body part.
